newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gehe confident Lloyds bid to be accepted.
newsitem.headline: Gehe confident Lloyds bid to be accepted.

text.p: German pharmaceutical group Gehe AG said on Tuesday that it was confident Lloyds Chemists Plc shareholders would accept its takeover bid.
Gehe said earlier on Tuesday it was offering 500p in cash per Lloyds Chemists share and 322.6p per preferenced share, an offer that values the British company at 650.6 million stg ($1.1 billion).

"We are confident that Lloyds shareholders will prefer the security of the Gehe cash takeover offer to the risks attached to Unichem's share exchange offer," Gehe cited its chief executive Dieter Kaemmerer as saying in a mandatory statement.
Gehe has been locked in a takeover battle for Lloyds Chemists with UK group Unichem Plc, which is offering 657.6 million stg in cash and shares.
Earlier this year, the German group made a 650 million stg cash offer for the company.
Unichem already owns 9.9 percent of Lloyds.
